difficulty: Not assigned: no empirical difficulty measurement.
review_scope: Passage-grounded AI review with recorded limitations; not 100 human-reviewed examples.
selection_bias: Initial seeded random pool; 28 editorial replacements selected from seed-638 shuffled unused test records with support under 650 characters. This favors short, clear, directly supported questions and is not a representative random benchmark.
remaining_limitations: Mostly recall questions. No missing-evidence cases. Shared supporting passages may occur in training corpus. Model pretraining contamination is unknown. Full passage factual accuracy is not independently verified.
